app.name: Skillsync
app.tagline: Where CVs and job needs finally sync.

auth.switchToSignUp: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.confirmEmailSent: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

common.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been removed.

jobs.title: Job Vacancies
jobs.subtitle: Every open role, with its AI-generated verification questions.
jobs.emptyBody: Create your first job to let AI generate 3 case-scenario questions that verify candidate CV claims.
jobs.deleteConfirm: "{title}" and all of its applications will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
jobs.deleteFailed: Failed to delete job. Please try again.

editJob.title: Edit Job
editJob.subtitle: Update the title or JD, and optionally regenerate the case-scenario questions.
editJob.regenerate: Regenerate the 3 AI scenario questions from the updated JD
editJob.errorSave: Failed to save changes. Your edits are still here — please try again.

newJob.title: Job Campaign Manager
newJob.subtitle: Paste a Job Description. AI generates 3 adaptive case-scenario questions to verify candidates' CV claims.
newJob.jdPlaceholder: Paste the full job description here...
newJob.errorRequired: Job title and description are required.
newJob.errorTooShort: Job description is too short (min {count} characters) to generate meaningful scenario questions.
newJob.enhanceHint: Type a short sketch and press "Enhance with AI" to expand it into a full description.
newJob.enhanceNeedsTitle: Add a job title first so AI knows what to expand.
newJob.enhanceNeedsNotes: Type a few notes about the role first.
newJob.enhanceFailed: AI failed to enhance the description. Please try again.
newJob.errorGenerate: AI failed to generate valid scenario questions. Your input is kept — please try again.

dashboard.subtitle: Candidate Scorecard Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Once a candidate applies and completes the verification assessment, they'll appear here ranked by match score.
dashboard.staleHint: Scoring may have been interrupted — the candidate can reopen their assessment link and resubmit.

detail.noTranscript: This candidate hasn't completed the assessment yet.

cv.empty: No CV data available for this candidate.

devTools.title: Dev Tools
devTools.subtitle: These utilities exist because the Candidate module (ResumeForge) has no UI yet. They are not part of the product and should not be shipped.
devTools.simulateBody: Creates a throwaway demo candidate and a pending application for the selected job, then opens the assessment page.
devTools.simulateNoJobs: No jobs yet — create one first.
devTools.seedBody: Instantly creates a job with 4 candidates at different match scores. No AI calls — useful when live generation is slow or unavailable.
